checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same matte black bottle recognizable, shape and details preserved
must.why: Same cap, loop, and body shape. The base ring is slightly more defined and the bottle looks a little re-rendered.

must.item: Bottle stands on a light stone kitchen counter, not the wooden table
must.why: It stands on a plain grey studio backdrop. There is no counter.

must.item: Tidy modern kitchen visible behind bottle
must.why: The background is a plain grey gradient with no kitchen.

must.item: Clean edges and believable contact shadow, not floating
must.why: Edges are clean. The grounding is soft, with a faint reflection and little visible contact shadow, but it does not float.
The image is 640x640 and has no text.

faults.what: The scene does not match the stone counter and modern kitchen the item expects. The output is a generic grey studio backdrop.
The bottle looks slightly re-rendered and CG-like. The base ring is more defined than in the original.

summary: The output is a clean grey studio shot of the same bottle, but it has no stone kitchen counter or modern kitchen background, so it misses the main scene requirement.
